scope:
Run the native side-pet attribute loop on synthetic factory pets.

The execution is limited to Player::refreshPlayerAttribute 0x99de84-0x99e620.
Only addEquipAtt is captured; pet refresh and loyalty arithmetic execute in ARM.
Separate setType/addKillEnemyNum samples check counters across role changes.
The game vector is synthetic and this does not run full UI, battle, save, or network.
